observations.content: The coding agent inspected frontier lifecycle and store tests, including a fixture policy with maximum_trial_cost_millionths_of_dollar 10 and spending_limit_millionths_of_dollar 15_000.

Frontier store tests cover durable creation, collision/path-escape rejection, semantic plan digest acceptance for pretty JSON, drift rejection, monotonic spend validation, idempotent trial replay, legacy trial filenames, and persistence of infrastructure events.

FrontierInfrastructureEvent in src/model.rs has model, artifact, case, attempt, infrastructure_attempt, message, and occurred_at fields; service.rs constructs these events for non-quota failures, while inspection selects the latest matching event by infrastructure_attempt.
The agent created git branch fix/agnt-0032-frontier-spend.
The agent successfully edited src/model.rs to add #[serde(default)] charged_millionths_of_dollar: u64 to FrontierInfrastructureEvent for backward-compatible deserialization.

An attempted service.rs refactor was not applied because the edit tool found two occurrences of a replacement target and required unique context; intended changes included charging infrastructure reservations, recomputing spend from trials plus infrastructure events, and treating invalid argument/configuration errors as terminal after persistence.
